title: September 11 attacks
summary: On the morning of 11 September 2001, 19 al-Qaeda members hijacked four airliners. Two were flown into the Twin Towers in New York, one into the Pentagon, and one crashed in a Pennsylvania field after passengers resisted. Both towers collapsed. The National September 11 Memorial & Museum counts 2,977 victims.

where.modern_name: World Trade Center site, Lower Manhattan, New York, USA (the other crash sites were the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, and a field in western Pennsylvania)
where.historical_name: World Trade Center, New York City, United States

importance.justification: Mass-casualty terrorist attack that destroyed the Twin Towers and reshaped US and world security policy.

audience_note: Describes a terrorist attack in which nearly 3,000 people died. No images of victims are shown.
reviewer_note: Death tolls differ by source and are attributed, not reconciled: the 9/11 Memorial FAQ gives 2,977 victims (2,753 in New York, 184 at the Pentagon, 40 on Flight 93); HISTORY gives 2,996 including the 19 hijackers and its own breakdown (2,753 / 189 / 44), which does not sum to its total. Pin is at the WTC site; the Pentagon and Pennsylvania sites are not separately pinned. Least sure of which tally to feature.
